bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM opinion distributions to human survey responses on gender-related multiple-choice questions from the OpinionQA dataset (based on Pew Research's American Trends Panel) to measure alignment error.
Comparing LLM opinion distributions to human survey responses on race-related multiple-choice questions from the OpinionQA dataset to measure alignment error.

Evaluating model alignment on political and cultural issues by comparing LLM opinion distributions against human survey responses on topics like 'Foreign Policy' and 'America in 2050', as well as testing different philosophical and ideological personas (e.g., 'social justice advocate', 'utilitarian') on the ETHICS dataset.
